name: series-hub
description: Series Hub — a Netflix-style OTT streaming experience (blue / black / red)

scripts.check:ssr: vite build --ssr scripts/ssr-check.jsx --outDir dist-ssr --logLevel warn && node dist-ssr/ssr-check.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npx cap add android && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npx cap add ios && npx cap sync
